content: Ana Da̱wuda kotoi adanshi na̱ Shawulu, a̱vu Jonata ulobo wa Shawulu uwwa ookolo a̱ yi e icigi ya̱ Da̱wuda lon. A̱vu u ciga yi tsa wuma wa̱ yi.
Diga o uranu u ndolo Shawulu ɓana ta̱ Da̱wuda, waru u lyawa yi u ka̱mba̱ o u'wa wa dada va̱ yi shi.
Reve Jonata yuwan nzuwulai na̱ Da̱wuda, adama a na u ciga yi ta̱ tsa wuma wa̱ yi.
Reve Jonata foɗo utugu u na u ri na̱ a̱yi wotowu, a̱vu u ca Da̱wuda, ni itana yu uvon ya̱ yi, na̱ matsun me pe'eni ma̱ yi, nu utan nu ujin wa̱ yi, na̱ gbakala va̱ yi.

Waru Da̱wuda tsu 'ya̱wa̱ ta̱ u lyuwa aci uba̱ta̱ u na Shawulu lyungu niyi uvon biti, reve Shawulu zuwa yi yali ya̱ a̱soja o uvon a̱ yi. Waru ili'i u yo'ono ta̱ ali o uvon suru, oɓolo na̱ nan yali yu uvon a Shawulu.
Tsushu'un tsa Shawulu a̱ tyo ya̱ Da̱wuda

Ana ali o uvon a Isra'ila a̱ ri a̱ ma̱ ka̱mba̱ o u'wa, mantsa ma na Da̱wuda ka̱mba̱i diga uba̱ta̱ u na wu unai Goliya, a̱vu a̱ma̱ci o uta̱ e ilyuci ya Isra'ila suru, adama a ga'asan na̱ Shawulu mogono, na̱ muganga ni ikumburu a̱ ma̱za̱nga̱ e ishipa nu uje'en.
Ele o uje'en a̱vu a cana,

content.text: <<Shawulu una ta̱ kpaku kupa va̱ yi,
waru Da̱wuda una ta̱ ukpakukupa kupa va̱ yi va̱ a̱bunda̱.>>

content: Reve Shawulu yuwan upan lon, a̱vu udammu u ndolo u damaton yi. A̱vu u damma, <<A cuwa ta̱ Da̱wuda na̱ ukpakukupa kupa va̱ a̱bunda̱ a̱mu gba shi kpaku kupa goon. Nye i ɗa i buwa niyi a na wa̱a̱ tsura̱ she tsugono goon ko?>>
Waru diga a mantsa mo ndolo a̱ ka̱ra̱ a̱vu Shawulu reme tsushu'un na̱ Da̱wuda.

O urana we ire a̱vu ruhu vama diga uba̱ta̱ wa̱ A̱sula̱ cipa̱a̱ Shawulu nu ucira, a̱vu wo o'wo a yuwusan adanshi e ikaka ya̱ A̱sula̱ a̱tsuma̱ o u'wa wa̱ yi tsa vuma vu ujaru, a mantsa mo ndolo gba Da̱wuda wa'asaa yi ta̱ kumburu, cine u tsu yuwusan. Shawulu gba da̱na̱ ta̱ ni ibata o ukere wa̱ yi.
A̱vu u sari yi, a majiyan okolo a̱yi, <<N ta sapalai Da̱wuda nu uɓaɓu.>> Amma Da̱wuda kanzu'usa ta̱ toto ure.
Shawulu uwwa ta̱ wovon wa̱ Da̱wuda adama a na A̱sulazuva o to oɓolo na̱ yi, amma A̱sulazuva a vadalaa ta̱ Shawulu ucina̱.
Ɗaɗa Shawulu tawa niyi a̱ ma̱ka̱ka̱n ma̱ yi reve u zuwa yi yali ya̱ a̱soja ukpakukupa (1,000) adama u walaa le elime uba̱ta̱ o uvon.
A̱tsuma̱ e ili i na Da̱wuda yuwain suru u tsa̱ra̱ ta̱ ulyuwu wa aci, adama a na A̱sulazuva o to oɓolo na̱ a̱yi.
Waru ana Shawulu enei Da̱wuda ta̱ tsura̱sa̱ ulyuwu wa aci lon, a̱vu wu uwwa wovon wa̱ yi lon.
Amma aza a Isra'ila na aza a Yahuda suru a ciga ta̱ Da̱wuda, adama a na u ta̱ ronuso le aɗanga ulobonu uba̱ta̱ o uvon.
Da̱wuda zuwa ta̱ usheli wa Shawulu

Ele lo reve Shawulu damma Da̱wuda, <<Apa usheli u kpara u va̱ Mera, n ta ca wu a̱yi lolo, vu yuwaan mu a̱ga̱nda̱ na̱ ukadu goon, waru vu yuwan uvon wa̱ A̱sulazuva.>> Adama a na Shawulu jiyan ta̱ a asuvu a̱ yi, <<Ma̱a̱ ya̱sa̱n ukere u va̱ ju'wa̱in shi, amma lyawa aza a Filistiya o una yi!>>
Da̱wuda damma ta̱ Shawulu, <<Zane ɗa n ri waru zane ɗa mmaci n va̱ ko umatsun wa dada va̱ a̱tsuma̱ a Isra'ila, hali a na mo o'wo toto mogono?>>
Amma a na mantsa ma rawai a na Shawulu a ca usheli wa̱ yi Mera lolo ekere Da̱wuda, reve u ca Adriye vuma va Mehola.
Mikal gba usheli wa Shawulu u ta̱ e icigi ya̱ Da̱wuda. Ana a dammai Shawulu aɗa a̱ yi, reve wu uwwa uyo'o lon.
Reve u jiyan o okolo a̱ yi, <<N ta ca yi a̱yi adama wo o'wo yi maza waru adama aza a Filistiya a̱tsura̱ o una yi.>> Ɗaɗa Shawulu dammai Da̱wuda we ire, <<Gogo vu to o'wo toto va̱.>>

A̱vu Shawulu damma agbashi a̱yi, <<Yuwain adanshi na̱ Da̱wuda usokowu i damma, <A̱yi ɗa nda mogono ma ta uwwusa na̱ a̱vu, waru suru agbashi a̱yi a ciga wu ta̱. Gogo nye yaa putsa a̱ wu a na va̱ usu a na voo o'wo toto va̱ yi?> >>
Reve agbashi a Shawulu a̱ ka̱mbuwa̱ Da̱wuda adanshi a nda usokowu. A̱vu Da̱wuda damma, <<I ta majiyan ili yu uro i ɗa a na moo o'wo toto mogono? A̱mu za vu ulambu ɗa waru ili i ro ɗa shi.>>
Ana agbashi a Shawulu a̱ ka̱mbuwa̱ niyi ili i na Da̱wuda dammai,

reve Shawulu damma, <<Dammai Da̱wuda, <Mogono ma ciga atsupu e ili i tsutoto i ro shi na a̱ ka̱ra̱i kwan vu ryumbu ukpaku (100) wa aza a Filistiya shi, adama u tsupa n'yuwatan ma̱ yi.> >> Majiyan ma Shawulu a̱yi ɗa adama Da̱wuda kuwa̱ e ekere aza a Filistiya.
Ana agbashi'i a dammai Da̱wuda adanshi a nda a̱vu Da̱wuda uwwa uyo'o lon a na wo o'wo toto mogono. Kafu mantsa ma atsupu e ikebe i lolo'o i rawa,

reve Da̱wuda 'yon oɓolo na̱ a̱soja a̱ yi, reve o una aza a Filistiya ukpakure (200). A̱vu Da̱wuda ta̱wa̱ na̱ kwan vu ryumbu le, a̱vu u ca mogono ele suru, adama wo o'wo toto mogono. Reve Shawulu ca yi usheli wa̱ yi Mikal lolo.
Ana Shawulu enei A̱sulazuva o to oɓolo na̱ Da̱wuda, waru usheli wa̱ yi Mikal ciga ta̱ Da̱wuda,
reve Shawulu da̱shi uwwa wovon wa̱ Da̱wuda, a̱vu wo o'wo ma'yuwatan ma̱ yi a akapi arana wuma wa̱ yi.
Mantsa ma na suru nan yali yu uvon a Filistiya o uta̱i adama a yuwan uvon na aza a Isra'ila, Da̱wuda tsu lyuwa ta̱ aci e le, u la'a akapi a yali yu uvon ya Shawulu, reve aala a̱ yi a̱ uta̱ lon.
